rationale: Excluded under E01 (wrong topic). Although this is an empirical qualitative interview study examining the suspension of workplace safety regulations, its subject matter is occupational health and safety of Latino day labourers in post-Katrina reconstruction, with no focus on household or community water or sanitation service access or water/sanitation access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: No difference between the narrow rule-type reading and the plain Criterion 2 reading; the study concerns occupational health, workplace safety regulations and labour conditions in post-hurricane reconstruction rather than water or sanitation service access (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: Occupational Health and Safety of Latino Day Laborers in the Aftermath of the Gulf Coast Hurricanes
After Katrina, the Bush administration suspended Department of Labor workplace regulations throughout the Gulf
Fifty-three immigrant workers and 28 key informants from community, union, church, and relief organizations in Louisiana and Mississippi were interviewed
